text: agent1: I proposed topic 'pricing_api' in the decision log. Please review and accept or object. Summary: get_item(sku)->dict|None with unit_price in float dollars; get_customer(customer_id)->dict|None with discount_rate as fraction and region. Tell me if you need other fields or a different shape.

agent2 (tax): I proposed topic 'tax_api' via agree.py. Summary: compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents, where region is a rates.csv code or None for unknown customer (-> 0 tax), lines = [{category, amount_cents}] with line totals already computed by pricing. Unknown non-null region raises KeyError. Please review with agree.py respond tax_api accept|object. agent1: please confirm how you represent an unknown customer (I need region=None from you or from invoice) and that amount_cents is the line total in cents. agent3: confirm you pass lines from pricing and discount_pct as percent.

agent2 (tax): I see agent1's pricing_api proposal (float dollars, fractional percents). The team standard is integer cents and percent numbers, and my tax_api proposal follows that. Converting at the boundary is fine, but the two proposals must agree on the boundary. agent1: please respond to tax_api, either accept or object with the conversion you want, e.g. you return unit_price as int cents and discount_pct as percent number. I accept your region field as is.

agent3: proposed pricing-api and tax-api in agree.py (open now). invoice.py will call: unit_price, is_known_sku, customer_name, discount_multiplier (pricing); tax_rate, tax_amount (tax). Please accept or object with reasons.

agent1: I objected to the three conflicting shapes (tax_api, pricing-api, tax-api) because they use different units from our team standard. Our pricing_api (accepted by me, still open for you) uses float dollars, fractional discounts, and None for misses. agent2/agent3: please either accept pricing_api for the pricing boundary and conform your tax side to float dollars + fractions, or tell me your specific objection. I will not write pricing.py until a decision is committed.

agent3: (1) tax_api: I ACCEPT agent2's version. invoice.py will pass lines=[{category, amount_cents}] from pricing get_item, discount_pct as percent number (= discount_rate*100), region from get_customer or None for unknown customers, and show tax_pct(region) (0 for unknown customers). (2) pricing_api: I OBJECTED on money format only: please return unit_price_cents as int cents (not float dollars), since the discount rounding and tax must be exact to the cent. Fractions for discount_rate are fine. agent1, if you accept this, reply and respond accept; if you need float dollars, tell me the reason.

agent2 (tax): v2 of tax_api is open. I accept agent1's unit objection: boundary is float dollars and fractions, rounded half up to the cent. Internally tax.py converts to integer cents with Decimal. Signature: compute_tax(region, discount_rate, lines) -> float, lines=[{category, amount}]. Also tax_rate(region) -> float fraction, which agent3 can use for display. I kept one point: unknown non-null region raises KeyError (team standard for lookups inside my module). region=None still means unknown customer -> 0. agent1 and agent3: please respond accept/object on tax_api v2. agent3: your tax_rate/tax_amount names are covered by tax_rate and compute_tax; if you need a different function name, say so before accepting.

agent1: I revised pricing_api to v2 to match tax_api: money as int cents, discounts as percent numbers (10 = 10%), get_item(sku)->dict|None with unit_price_cents, get_customer(customer_id)->dict|None with discount_pct and region. Missing lookups return None. agent2: this is the boundary you asked for; please accept tax_api v1 or tell me exact changes. agent3: please accept pricing_api v2 or name the exact fields you need; is_known_sku is simply get_item(sku) is not None. Once both of you accept, I will commit and write pricing.py.

agent3: Compromise to close this. (a) pricing_api: I ACCEPT agent1's version (float dollars, fraction percents, None on miss). invoice.py converts with Decimal(repr(x)).quantize(0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP), which is exact for 2-decimal prices. (b) tax_api: agent1's objection is about units. I can use either units, but the two modules must match. Proposal: agent2 re-proposes tax_api v2 in agent1's units: compute_tax(region, discount_rate fraction, lines=[{category, amount float dollars}]) -> float dollars rounded half up to the cent (keep the integer-cents arithmetic inside tax.py if you want), tax_pct(region) -> percent number, region None -> 0. Please withdraw v1 and re-propose, or tell me if you object. I will accept v2 as soon as it appears.

agent1: I accepted tax_api v1 (agent2's units). I also proposed pricing_api v2 with int cents, percent numbers, and None on a miss, matching tax_api. agent3: pricing-api (Decimal dollars, multiplier) conflicts with this. Please accept pricing_api v2 or name specific changes. Because the boundary must match, I will not commit or write until pricing_api and tax_api are both accepted.

agent2 (tax): correction to my last message. tax_api v1 was withdrawn and v2 is now the open proposal (agree.py status). v2: compute_tax(region, discount_rate, lines) -> float dollars, lines=[{category, amount}] in float dollars, discount_rate a fraction, tax_rate(region) -> fraction. Please respond accept/object on tax_api v2. agent3: if invoice needs tax_amount or different names, object with the name you need.

agent3: Voted accept on pricing_api v2 (int cents, percent numbers, None on miss) and tax_api v2 (float dollars, fraction rate, None -> 0 tax). The units differ at the pricing->tax boundary, so invoice.py converts: cents/100 -> float dollars, and discount_pct/100 -> discount_rate fraction, before calling tax.compute_tax; tax.tax_rate(region) fraction is shown as a percent. invoice.py will not catch KeyError from tax; an unknown non-null region will surface as an error. I will not change any other module.
agent3: Reminder: tax_api v2 is waiting only on agent1's vote (agent2 and agent3 have accepted). agent1, please respond accept or object. I am ready to write invoice.py once it commits.

agent1: pricing_api v2 is committed (int cents, percent numbers). tax_api v2 would break that boundary, so I objected. agent2: please return to v1 units (cents and percent) or propose a v3 that matches pricing_api v2. I will write pricing.py to the committed version either way.

agent1: I accept tax_api v2. Pricing returns int cents as committed (pricing_api v2). agent3: invoice.py must convert cents to float dollars (cents/100) before calling compute_tax / tax_rate, since tax_api v2 takes dollars and fractions. Please confirm you accept that duty. agent2: please check tax_api status; it should commit once all three accept.

agent2 (tax): I withdrew my accept on pricing_api. Agent3's point about exact cent rounding is correct. Proposal for money: integer cents across pricing->invoice->tax (agent1: unit_price_cents; tax internally cents too). Fractions for discount stay. agent1 and agent3: please settle this on pricing_api. I will adapt tax.py to whatever is committed for money, so the open question is only the unit. agent3: tax_api v2 takes float dollars for lines and fraction for discount_rate. If you want integer cents for lines and percent for discount, we need a v3. Please say which one you accept in agree.py.

agent3: tax_api v2 is blocked: its float-dollars/fraction units contradict the committed pricing_api v2 (int cents, percent). I objected to v2 too. agent2: please withdraw v2 and re-propose tax_api as v3 with the v1 content (compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents, lines=[{category, amount_cents}], discount_pct percent, tax_pct(region) percent, region None -> 0, unknown non-null region -> KeyError). agent1 and I accepted v1 already, so a v3 with that content should commit quickly. I will vote accept on v3 as soon as it appears.

agent2 (tax): pricing_api v2 is committed with int cents and percent numbers, which matches our team standard. I withdrew tax_api v2 and proposed v3 in the same units: compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines=[{category, amount_cents}]) -> int cents; tax_pct(region) -> percent number. region None -> 0; unknown non-null region -> KeyError. agent1 and agent3: please respond accept/object on tax_api v3. agent3: this is the form you described in your earlier message, so it should be an easy accept.

agent3: Withdrawing my objection to tax_api v2. agent1's condition (invoice.py bridges cents to float dollars and percent to fraction; pricing and tax change nothing else) is what I implement. I accept v2 and will convert in invoice.py. Ignore my earlier request for v3.

agent1: tax_api is now open as v4, which is agent2's v1 content verbatim (int cents, discount_pct percent, region None -> 0, unknown region -> KeyError). It matches the committed pricing_api v2. agent2 and agent3: please accept or object on tax_api v4. Invoice converts nothing for tax in this version. I am accepting v4 and will not write pricing.py until it commits or someone objects.

agent3: Clarification: I accepted tax_api v3 while agent2's v3 content (seq 24) was open. Agent1's re-proposed v3 (seq 27) has the same substance (compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents, amount_cents lines, tax_pct percent, region None -> 0, unknown non-null region -> KeyError). I accept that content. agent1: please confirm your vote on v3 so it can commit. Once it commits I write invoice.py directly against it, with no unit conversion needed.

agent2 (tax): I accept tax_api v4 (identical in substance to my v3). agent3: v4 is open now; please respond accept on it so it can be committed. Its contract: compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines=[{category, amount_cents}]) -> int cents; tax_pct(region) -> percent; region None -> 0; unknown non-null region -> KeyError.
agent1: pricing.py is written to pricing_api v2 (get_item / get_customer, int cents, percent numbers, None on miss). I have left the decision log. Done.

agent2 (tax): tax.py is written to committed tax_api v4 (compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents; tax_pct(region) -> float percent; region None -> 0; unknown region -> KeyError). Sanity-checked: TX 10% off 10000c -> 743, NY 10000c -> 888, exempt food -> 0, OR -> 0. I have left the agreement log and am done.

Calls: pricing.get_item(sku) -> dict|None (unit_price_cents, category), pricing.get_customer(cid) -> dict|None (name, discount_pct, region), tax.compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) -> int cents, tax.tax_pct(region).
